rendered: The NiTi wires were strained axially to lock in strain on the V2O5 film, at substrate strains of 5%[1] and 10%[2]. These applied strains were maintained after unloading through the shape memory property of the NiTi alloy. The wires were pulled in axial tensile deformation, as stated here: axial tensile strains of 0−10%[3]. The strains actually used in the straining of the surface coating were also reported as: 5%[4] and 10%[5].
